content.help: Look at another player in your party and press this key to open their inventory. Default: Y.
Press this key to allow or forbid other players from opening your inventory. Default: H.

content.text: Let other players open my inventory
content.help: When on, party members near you can open your inventory. Your party members must also have this mod. Off by default.

content.text: Only open players who allow it
content.help: When on, you can only open the inventory of players who turned on the option above. Leave this on unless you know why not.
Which item menu opens. 'Take and give' lets you both take items and give items, like a follower's inventory.
How close you must be to another player to open their inventory, in game units. Vanilla activation reach is about 150 to 250.
Show a message when someone opens or closes your inventory, and for errors when you try to open one.
